description: issue #680 (Interaction & Events, slice I1): `wait 2` pauses the current top-level instruction stream for 2 ticks and emits a single `primitive` event carrying only `name: "wait"` AFTER the pause completes (spec/interaction-events.md's `### wait <n>` and "Trace stream integration": "wait emits a `primitive` event after the pause completes"). The tick clock is headless execution state, so no tick count or timing leaks into the payload (spec/execution-model.md's trace-and-event registry). The `primitive` catch-all kind is registered by C5 (#694); M5 adds no new event kind.
